children.description: thumb|Advanced infection and colonization of onion bulb tissue by the Botrytis fungus, note brown to gray discoloration of onion tissue, and formation of black sclerotial bodies between onion scale.

children.name: Botrytis cinerea
children.description: Botrytis cinerea is a necrotrophic (feeding on dead tissue) fungus that affects many plant species, including wine grapes.

children.name: Botrytis elliptica
children.description: Botrytis elliptica is a necrotrophic fungal pathogen which infects species of plants in the Lilium genus, causing the disease commonly known as Lily Gray Mold.

children.name: Botrytis fabae
children.description: Botrytis fabae is a plant pathogen, a fungus that causes chocolate spot disease of broad or fava bean plants, Vicia faba.
